# function: application_signals_instrumentation_config

Builds the ARN for `application-signals` `instrumentationConfig`:

```
arn:${Partition}:application-signals:${Region}:${Account}:instrumentationConfig/${Service}/${Environment}/${SignalType}/${LocationHash}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:application-signals:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:instrumentationConfig/service/environment/signal-type/location-hash
output "application_signals_instrumentation_config" {
  value = provider::arn::application_signals_instrumentation_config("service", "environment", "signal-type", "location-hash")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
application_signals_instrumentation_config(service string, environment string, signal_type string, location_hash string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `service` (String) Value for `${Service}` in the ARN template.
1. `environment` (String) Value for `${Environment}` in the ARN template.
1. `signal_type` (String) Value for `${SignalType}` in the ARN template.
1. `location_hash` (String) Value for `${LocationHash}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
